claimedSlice: opencv2/cudawarping.hpp parser-backed CUDA image-warping public declarations plus the pinned module CMake build/dependency contract
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact CudaWarping wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The cudawarping module is disabled unless the OpenCV build enables CUDA or CUDA stubs and is unavailable on iOS/WinRT; real remap/resize/warp execution depends on an external CUDA toolkit/runtime and NPP image-warping libraries.

The module requires opencv_core, opencv_imgproc, and opencv_geometry, optionally opencv_cudev, with GpuMat/Stream data, asynchronous execution policy, and map/output ownership outside this package; no CUDA warping wrapper/runtime is bundled.
